name: Sentry
shortDescription: Real-time error tracking and performance monitoring with source maps and session replay.
description: Real-time error tracking, performance monitoring, and release health with source maps and stack traces across frontend, backend, and edge.

useCases: Release health monitoring with stack traces
Session replay for debugging user issues
